title: Raku Workshop Summer 2025
host_org: New York New Jersey Academy of Ceramic Art
how_to_join: Register via How to Register page
summary: One-day raku firing workshop taught by Academy founder Frank Bosco on June 29, 2025. Participants bring their own bisque pieces; the workshop includes instruction, studio use, glazes, and reduction options, with a 4-student limit.
source_quote: Raku Workshop SUMMER 2025 Course ID: RAKU Sunday June 29th 11am-6pm
evidence_sentence: The Raku Workshop page describes a raku firing event on June 29th with instruction and reduction options.
evidence_quote: Placed in the kiln and heated up rapidly until glowing and glossy with a molten glaze, the vessels are immediately removed from the kiln using long handled tongs and allowed to cool in the open air or doused in water.
